senses: to esteem lightly, think little of
lex:
ὀλιγωρέω, -ῶ
(ὀλίγος + ὤρα, care), [in LXX: Pro.3:11 (מָאַס)* ;]
to esteem lightly, think little of: with genitive, Heb.12:5 (LXX),†

strongs.def: to have little regard for, i.e. to disesteem
strongs.from: from a compound of G3641 (ὀλίγος) and ("care")
